narrativeGoal: Hold the signal-to-outcome composition in one frame.
visualDescription: Editorial macro photograph of charcoal paper topography. A single unmistakable flat neon chartreuse line, hex color impression #D7FF52, crosses the dark relief from scattered points into one precise path. The chartreuse is the only colored element. Dramatic but quiet side light, empty center-left, no text, no amber, no orange, no gold, no copper.
